name: comp-411
blurb: Bordered pill-shaped avatar group with overflow indicator.
description: Renders four circular avatars at 40px size inside a bordered rounded-pill container with subtle shadow and an overflow button showing "+3". Avatars use ring-background styling to match container.
use_when: Avatar groups that need clear visual definition with a border, like in elevated cards or highlighted sections.
avoid_when: When avatars need to blend in, or when the count of hidden avatars is dynamic.
a11y: Avatar images have alt text. The overflow button is a Button component with keyboard and focus support.
